requirements.statement: more_itertools.consecutive_groups accepts a new `step` option, passed as the keyword argument step=... . When given, it yields groups that are maximal runs of consecutive input items in which each item is exactly `step` more than the item before it; a new group starts wherever the difference from the previous item is not `step`. User example: consecutive_groups([2, 4, 6, 10, 12], step=2) yields the groups [2, 4, 6] and [10, 12].
